newsitem.title: USA: Xerox adopts new shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Xerox adopts new shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Xerox Corp said Monday that it has adopted a new shareholder rights plan, substantially similar to the expiring one, which will take effect when the current plan expires April 16.
The company said the the rights will be distributed as a dividend at the rate of one right per share to shareholders of record, April 16.

Under the plan, said the company, rights generally will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires beneficial ownership of 20 percent or more of the company's common stock or commences a tender or exchange offer which, upon consummation, would result in a person or group owning 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
Separately, the company said it has named two senior vice-presidents, Louis Rupnick and Norman Rickard, and one new vice-president, Tom Dolan.
Xerox said that all three would be key executives in the company's worldwide document processing business.
